rows.title: Untouchable core protects the merge gate from self-modification
rows.decision: The verification gate is extracted from the code it verifies; the "operator-modifiable only" premise is retired.
rows.readWhen: Touching `src/untouchable.ts` or the gate/verifier boundary.

rows.title: One target per orchestrator instance; fleet later via systemd
rows.decision: One Target per orchestrator instance; multi-target inside one orchestrator is rejected — run a second instance.
rows.readWhen: Adding per-target config, or tempted to namespace Redis per target.

rows.title: Target outcomes are terminal; 25% capacity floor for orchestrator self-improvement
rows.decision: Target Outcomes are the terminal goal; orchestrator self-improvement is instrumental but holds a 25% capacity floor.
rows.readWhen: Prioritising work, or arguing self-improvement vs Target work.

rows.title: Self-modification tiers with outcome-holdback for the middle tier
rows.decision: The original tier ladder as *merge authority* — retired; read 0015 instead.
rows.readWhen: Historical only — reading old tier-authority references.

rows.title: Operator escalation only when no autonomous remedy exists
rows.statusLine: accepted (closed escalation list amended by ADR-0020)
rows.decision: Escalate to the operator only for a closed list; everything else Hydra researches and tries autonomously.
rows.readWhen: Deciding whether something needs the operator.

rows.title: Codex CLI fully removed; autopilot is the only execution path
rows.statusLine: Accepted, 2026-05-14. Supersedes the measurement-gated rollout in [`docs/codex-removal-measurement.md`](../codex-removal-measurement.md) (kept as historical record of the original plan).
rows.decision: Codex CLI and the in-process planner/executor/skeptic agents are deleted; autopilot is the only execution path.
rows.readWhen: Finding an orphaned reference to the old control loop.

rows.title: Decision-brain orchestration for /hydra-autopilot
rows.decision: Autopilot decisions are a pure Python function — `scripts/autopilot/decide.py` returns a typed action Plan the model executes verbatim.
rows.readWhen: Changing dispatch logic or `decide.py`.

rows.title: Design-Concept Gate
rows.decision: A design-concept artifact is required before any `dev_orch` / `dev_target` dispatch.
rows.readWhen: Working on the dispatch gate or `src/design-concept.ts`.

rows.title: Redis access goes through typed domain accessors
rows.statusLine: Accepted (sharpened by ADR-0017 — three access categories + sanctioned Event Bus raw-wire seam)
rows.decision: Redis access goes through typed domain accessors in `src/redis/*`; key generators never escape the seam.
rows.readWhen: Any Redis read or write. **Read 0017 with it.**

rows.title: Stuckness detector retired; self-improvement floor is operator-curated
rows.decision: The automated Stuckness detector is deleted; the self-improvement floor is operator-curated via `priorities.md`.
rows.readWhen: Finding a `stuckness` reference, or proposing an automated trip wire.

rows.title: HTTP request body validation goes through `src/schemas/*`
rows.decision: HTTP `req.body` validates through a `src/schemas/*` zod schema; the schema is the source of truth for parser and type.
rows.readWhen: Adding or changing a POST/PUT/PATCH route.

rows.title: Autopilot is the single decisional brain; state is continuous via Redis + hooks
rows.statusLine: Accepted (live doctrine — the single-brain model is what `hydra-autopilot` runs today; corrected from "Proposed" 2026-08-12)
rows.decision: Autopilot is the single decisional brain; state is continuous in Redis; subagent blockers are handled autonomously under a per-task budget.
rows.readWhen: Any autopilot, scheduler, or dispatch-state work.

rows.title: Hydra is a swappable single-target builder; generality lives in the swap
rows.statusLine: Accepted (Decision 2 amended 2026-09-02 — hydra-betting retired as the crucible, Claw Street Bets adopted as crucible #2; see the **CSB amendment** at the end)
rows.decision: Hydra is a swappable single-target builder — generality lives in the *swap*, never in the *session*. hydra-betting is retired as the crucible; Claw Street Bets (trading P&L) succeeds it; the fork stays (B) and the 25% floor survives.
rows.readWhen: Proposing multi-target or "make it general" work, or asking which Target is the crucible and why.

rows.title: Simplicity is a measured discipline, not an aesthetic goal
rows.decision: Optimise for measured low change-cost, not for felt simplicity; five operating rules including "prune docs like code".
rows.readWhen: Architecture review, or justifying a new subsystem.

rows.title: Self-modification tiers are verification depth, not merge authority
rows.statusLine: accepted (supersedes ADR-0001 and ADR-0004 on the merge-authority question)
rows.decision: A Modification Tier is verification *depth*, not merge *authority*; every tier has an autonomous merge path.
rows.readWhen: Any tier question. **This is the live tier doctrine.**

rows.title: Cycle/task tracking is autopilot-recorded; the in-process task-tracker is retired
rows.decision: Cycle/task state is recorded post-hoc by autopilot via `cycle-tracking.ts`; `src/task-tracker.ts` is deleted, and cost is a token plane with no USD column.
rows.readWhen: Touching cycle metrics, `recordCycle`, or cost attribution.

rows.title: Redis seam sharpened: three access categories + a sanctioned Event Bus raw-wire seam
rows.decision: Three Redis access categories: typed accessors, the Event Bus as sanctioned raw owner, and local-only state.
rows.readWhen: Any Redis work — pairs with 0009.

rows.title: The design-concept canonical-ref invariant lives at the persistence seam
rows.decision: The design-concept `anchorRef` is canonicalised at the accessor seam, not by every caller.
rows.readWhen: Touching `src/redis/design-concept.ts`.

rows.title: Tier→merge-policy is a named predicate, not a magic integer scattered across callers
rows.decision: `src/tier-policy.ts` owns the tier→policy predicates; the merge-policy boundary is defined once.
rows.readWhen: Changing auto-merge eligibility or breaking-change rules.

rows.title: Deep-QA PASS marker gates T4 auto-merge
rows.statusLine: accepted (extends ADR-0015; amends ADR-0005's closed list)
rows.decision: A positive `Verifier-Core deep-QA: PASS @ <sha>` PR comment is the proof that gates T4 auto-merge.
rows.readWhen: Working on T4 changes or the deep-QA gate.

rows.title: Usage-paced 24/7 autopilot via an admission-control Pace Gate
rows.statusLine: Accepted (live doctrine — the Pace Gate runs in production as `pace-gate.service`; corrected from "Proposed" 2026-08-12)
rows.decision: The Pace Gate is an admission-control supervisor pacing total burn along a linear curve to a sub-100% weekly ceiling.
rows.readWhen: Anything touching quota, pacing, or `pace-gate.service`.

rows.title: Query-param validation goes through `src/schemas/*` for GET read routes
rows.decision: `req.query` on GET read routes validates through `src/schemas/*` on ADR-0011's mechanic.
rows.readWhen: Adding or changing a GET route with query params.

rows.title: The global reflection buffer is retired; Reflections is per-anchor + by-file only
rows.decision: The global reflection buffer is deleted; Reflections has exactly two surfaces — per-anchor and by-file.
rows.readWhen: Touching `src/reflections/` or the learning context.

rows.title: API versioning & deprecation strategy (registry-first, no migration yet)
rows.decision: Generated catalogue: `docs/generated/routes.json` (`npm run docs:inventories`) enumerates the surface; pick the versioning mechanism when first needed, migrate nothing now. Amended twice in 2026-09 — §3 zero-consumer one-step exception (#4356); §1/§3 generated route catalogue + `@stability` annotations (#4587).
rows.readWhen: Adding an endpoint, or proposing `/v2`.

rows.title: Target gets its own single-realm incident skill (hydra-target-incident)
rows.decision: Incident skills are single-realm: `hydra-incident` never leaves `~/hydra`, `hydra-target-incident` never leaves `~/hydra-betting`.
rows.readWhen: Editing either incident skill.

rows.title: Target Manifest — per-target build/gate facts live in the target repo, not orchestrator `src/`
rows.decision: The Target Manifest (`.hydra/manifest.json`) declares per-target build/gate facts in the target repo, not orchestrator `src/`.
rows.readWhen: Hardcoding a target fact in `src/`, or touching `src/target-config.ts`.

rows.title: pino structured logger — machine-parseable log lines as the canonical logging seam
rows.decision: pino behind the `src/logger.ts` deep-module seam is the canonical logger; migrate `console.*` incrementally, one module per PR.
rows.readWhen: Adding any log line.

rows.title: Builder-Health Measurement Subsystem — a per-realm metric panel, not a composite index
rows.decision: Builder health is a panel of four per-realm signals — never a single blended index or weighted score.
rows.readWhen: Touching builder-health metrics, or proposing a composite score.

rows.title: hydra-autopilot charts and works wayfinder maps
rows.decision: Autopilot charts and works wayfinder maps, but never synthesises the operator's side of a decision; HITL tickets stay off the AFK board.
rows.readWhen: Working on wayfinder maps, `wayfinder_orch`, or HITL routing.

rows.title: One autonomous Pocock skill lineage replaces the hydra-prd/dev/qa forks
rows.decision: One autonomy-capable skill lineage in two modes (interactive / AFK) replaces the `hydra-prd`/`dev`/`qa` fork triplet.
rows.readWhen: Editing any spine skill or dispatch class.

rows.title: Target task tracking migrates from Redis to GitHub Issues
rows.decision: Target work tracks as GitHub Issues on `gaberoo322/hydra-betting`, label-driven, reusing the Orchestrator's board machinery.
rows.readWhen: Any Target board or backlog work.

rows.title: GLM dev-drainer worker lane
rows.statusLine: Accepted (Decision 2 corrected 2026-07-27 by issue #3758 — see the **#3758 amendment**)
rows.decision: GLM is a fenced *worker* draining shallow `dev_orch` work on z.ai quota — never a brain, never Verifier Core, never money-critical.
rows.readWhen: Touching the GLM drainer or its fence.

rows.title: The OpenViking knowledge plane is retired
rows.decision: The OpenViking knowledge plane is retired outright, not ported to a successor backend.
rows.readWhen: Proposing semantic search, or finding a `knowledge-base` reference.

rows.title: The Orchestrator dashboard is a five-page cockpit organised by operator journey
rows.decision: The dashboard is five pages organised by operator journey (plus two detail views), each answering exactly one question; only `/health` is phone-grade — plus one reference surface, `/docs` (§10), outside the journey count. §8: the Today feed is six fixed-order buckets whose items carry a typed recommended action from one checked-in registry. §9: a four-rung parity contract pinned in `parity.ts`. Amended 2026-09 — §1 sidebar rule, §10 `/docs` (#4587); §8 guidance layer + §9 parity contract (#4416).
rows.readWhen: Touching `dashboard/`, the attention feed, `src/operator-actions/`, or proposing a new dashboard surface or HTTP route.

rows.title: The spec stage stays Hydra-owned — `to-spec` is not its base
rows.decision: The spec stage stays Hydra-owned; `to-spec` is not its base — the two skills contradict each other on instruction, output artifact, and consumer. Supersedes ADR-0030 Decision 2's spec binding.
rows.readWhen: Tempted to compose `hydra-grill` on `_vendor/to-spec.md`, or wondering why the spec stage has no upstream base.

rows.title: Anchor selection retired; the Candidate Feed is data, not decisions
rows.statusLine: Accepted (live doctrine — `selectAnchor()` and `src/anchor-selection/` are deleted; corrected from "Proposed" 2026-08-12)
rows.decision: Anchor selection is retired; the Candidate Feed is data the brain reads, not a decision the orchestrator makes. Establishes the **Locality** principle. Renumbered from a duplicate `0016` — see Numbering below.
rows.readWhen: Touching candidate scoring, or tempted to resurrect the reframe queue.

rows.title: Hydra ADRs are agent-facing normative specs, not one-paragraph memory aids
rows.decision: Hydra ADRs are agent-facing normative specs: Pocock's write gate applies, its one-paragraph size target does not.
rows.readWhen: Before writing a new ADR, or before "fixing" the corpus to be shorter.

rows.title: The test suite is not padded — consolidate it, never shrink it
rows.decision: The test suite is not padded — consolidate it mechanically; do not delete, semantically rewrite, or parallelise it. The metric is operator Claude quota, not CI minutes.
rows.readWhen: Tempted to trim the test suite, hunt flaky tests, or parallelise the runner.

rows.title: The dependency graph is a seam Hydra owns; extractors are swappable producers
rows.decision: The dependency graph is a seam Hydra owns; extractors are swappable producers. TS uses a sound resolver, not a regex or tree-sitter; Graphify is a candidate producer, never a substrate.
rows.readWhen: Proposing a third-party code-graph tool, or touching `scanArchitecture()` / `/api/architecture`.

rows.title: The GLM drainer's decision logic is typed TypeScript that owns the tick, and GLM eligibility is one shared predicate
rows.decision: The GLM drainer's decision logic is typed TypeScript owning the tick (gate → pick → finish → tick); GLM eligibility is two shared pure predicates (`glmLane`, `glmPickVerdict`) in `src/glm/eligibility.ts`.
rows.readWhen: Touching `scripts/glm/drainer-loop.sh`, `src/glm/`, or any copy of the `glm-eligible` rules (sweep, board-state, collect-state, watchdog).

rows.title: Skill generation is a typed TypeScript core that returns a whole-corpus write plan; Codex skill generation is retired
rows.decision: Skill generation is a pure TS core in `src/skills/` returning a whole-corpus write plan (all-or-nothing sync), migrated by strangler with a live byte-parity test; the grammar copies import it; Codex skill generation is retired.
rows.readWhen: Touching `scripts/sync-skills.sh`, `src/skills/`, or any code that parses operator-playbook frontmatter / `@include` / `compose_base`.

rows.title: `src/cost/` is layered by purity, with a test-enforced import rule
rows.decision: `src/cost/` is layered by purity (L1 vocab+math … L6 derived reads); every import, value or type, points same-or-down; `test/cost-layers.test.mts` enforces it (dep-cruiser is an advisory twin). L1–L2 import direct; L3+ only via `index.ts`. Normative in `src/cost/` only.
rows.readWhen: Touching `src/cost/`, adding a file there, or importing from it outside the barrel.

rows.title: The Turn Snapshot is a typed TypeScript module; `collect-state.sh` is strangled
rows.decision: The Turn Snapshot (`src/autopilot/turn-snapshot/`) is a typed TS module behind injected adapters, run as a one-shot CLI; `collect-state.sh` is strangled collector-by-collector with byte-identical golden files, ending in a JSON snapshot `decide.py` reads; new signals are TS collectors.
rows.readWhen: Touching `collect-state.sh`, adding an autopilot signal, or changing what `decide.py` reads.
